caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is a conversation with the landscape, and the mountains here always have the final word. I designed our riding routes to embrace these sudden transitions—from wide gravel tracks to steep, grassy ridge lines that require you to stop, breathe, and choose your line with intent. Every kilometer we guide is one I have scouted on these exact slopes, looking for the perfect balance of challenge and raw beauty. It is not about speed; it is about the perspective you earn at the top.
